info.title: Eco-Drone API
info.description: API for managing eco-friendly drone delivery operations including drones, orders, trips, and locations

get.description: Latest sensor readings by drone (stubbed until sensors integrated)
Environmental data per flight (stubbed; derived from trips where available)
Aggregated sensor data over time (stubbed until sensors integrated)
High-level metrics for dashboard cards and today's chart
Chronological list of recent activity for the activity panel
Aggregated vendor metrics over a date range
Aggregated drone/flight metrics over a date range
Orders count and percentage per dropoff location
List of user events (e.g. orders placed) for Reports tab
Orders count per hour for chart (optional; dashboard-summary includes today)

post.description: Create a new user. Admin-created accounts have should_reset_password set to true.

get.description: Get paginated list of users with optional type filter
Retrieve a single user by ID

patch.description: Update a user by ID. All body fields are optional.

delete.description: Delete a user by ID. Admins cannot delete their own account.

403.description: Forbidden (admin required or cannot delete self)

get.description: Paginated list of audit log entries with optional filters (admin only)

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Filter by resource type (user, order, drone, vendor, trip)

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password
Authenticate user and receive JWT access and refresh tokens
Exchange a valid refresh token for new access and refresh tokens
Set new password and clear should_reset_password (requires authentication)
Update user account information (requires authentication)

delete.description: Permanently delete a user account (requires authentication)

post.description: Create a shopping cart for a user

delete.description: Remove a cart and all its items

get.description: Retrieve cart details including all items
Retrieve a user's cart with all items

post.description: Add a menu item to the shopping cart with quantity
Update the quantity of an item in the cart

delete.description: Delete a specific item from the cart

get.description: Retrieve all items in a specific cart

Update the battery level of an existing drone

delete.description: Remove a drone from the system

post.description: Assign an available drone to a specific order

400.description: Bad request (drone not available or battery too low)

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific drone by ID
Retrieve a paginated list of all drones in the system

post.description: Add a new delivery location with coordinates
Update coordinates and name of an existing location

delete.description: Remove a location from the system

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific location by ID
Retrieve a paginated list of all locations

Update details of an existing menu item

get.summary: Get paginated list of menu items
get.description: Retrieve all menu items with pagination

Update the quantity of an item in an order

delete.description: Remove an item from an order

get.description: Retrieve all items in a specific order

post.description: Create a delivery order with pickup and dropoff locations
Update pickup/dropoff locations and assigned drone for an order

delete.description: Remove an order from the system

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific order by ID
Retrieve a paginated list of all orders

Update the status of an existing trip

delete.description: Remove a trip from the system

Retrieve a paginated list of all trips

Mark a trip as completed and record the end time

get.description: Returns the vendor associated with the authenticated user (vendor account required).
Returns all menu items for the current vendor.

post.summary: Create a menu item for current vendor
post.description: Creates a new menu item owned by the current vendor.

patch.summary: Update a menu item for current vendor
patch.description: Updates an existing menu item that belongs to the current vendor.

delete.summary: Delete a menu item for current vendor
delete.description: Deletes an existing menu item that belongs to the current vendor.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of orders that contain at least one order item belonging to the current vendor. Each order only includes this vendor's items in its order_item array.

post.summary: Mark all items for this vendor in an order as fulfilled
post.description: Sets vendor_fulfilled_at for all order items in the order that belong to the current vendor.

200.description: Order items for this vendor marked fulfilled

403.description: Vendor account required or no items for this vendor

patch.summary: Mark all items for this vendor in an order as fulfilled (alias)

200.description: Order items for this vendor marked fulfilled

403.description: Vendor account required or no items for this vendor

patch.summary: Mark a single order item for this vendor as fulfilled
patch.description: Sets vendor_fulfilled_at for one order_item that belongs to the given order and to the current vendor.

403.description: Vendor account required or item does not belong to vendor
